1	// cxtool computes a deterministic complexity/coverage/churn baseline for a Go
2	// repository and rolls it up by "feature" using a file→feature mapping.
3	//
4	//	cxtool -root . -features features.json -cover a.out,b.out -churn-days 90,180 -out out/
5	//
6	// Metrics per function: LOC, cyclomatic (gocyclo), cognitive (gocognit),
7	// statements + covered statements (from cover profiles, merged per block with
8	// the maximum count seen). Metrics per file: the above summed, plus churn.
9	// Metrics per feature: the above summed over files per the mapping owned by
10	// internal/cx. Generated files (ast.IsGenerated) are counted in LOC but
11	// excluded from complexity. Features whose rule sets norank:true are measured
12	// but excluded from ranking tables.
13	package main
14	
15	import (
16		"bufio"
17		"bytes"
18		"encoding/json"
19		"flag"
20		"fmt"
21		"go/ast"
22		"go/parser"
23		"go/token"
24		"go/types"
25		"io/fs"
26		"os"
27		"os/exec"
28		"path"
29		"path/filepath"
30		"runtime"
31		"sort"
32		"strconv"
33		"strings"
34		"sync"
35		"time"
36	
37		"cxtool/internal/cx"
38	
39		"github.com/fzipp/gocyclo"
40		"github.com/uudashr/gocognit"
41	)
42	
43	// Warning thresholds; flag-settable so retuning them never renames a column.
44	var (
45		cycloWarn  = flag.Int("cyclo-warn", 15, "count functions with cyclomatic complexity above this")
46		cognitWarn = flag.Int("cognit-warn", 20, "count functions with cognitive complexity above this")
47		covWarn    = flag.Float64("cov-warn", 50, "a function below this coverage %% counts as under-covered")
48	)
49	
50	// ---------- data model ----------
51	
52	type Func struct {
53		File    string `json:"file"`
54		Pkg     string `json:"pkg"`
55		Name    string `json:"name"`
56		Start   int    `json:"start"`
57		End     int    `json:"end"`
58		LOC     int    `json:"loc"`
59		Cyclo   int    `json:"cyclo"`
60		Cognit  int    `json:"cognit"`
61		Stmts   int    `json:"stmts"`
62		Covered int    `json:"covered"`
63		Feature string `json:"feature"`
64		Area    string `json:"area"`
65	}
66	
67	func (f *Func) CovPct() float64 {
68		if f.Stmts == 0 {
69			return -1
70		}
71		return 100 * float64(f.Covered) / float64(f.Stmts)
72	}
73	
74	type Churn struct {
75		Commits int `json:"commits"`
76		Added   int `json:"added"`
77		Deleted int `json:"deleted"`
78	}
79	
80	type File struct {
81		Rel       string           `json:"rel"`
82		PkgDir    string           `json:"pkg_dir"`
83		IsTest    bool             `json:"is_test"`
84		Generated bool             `json:"generated"`
85		Ranked    bool             `json:"ranked"`
86		LOC       int              `json:"loc"` // physical lines
87		SumCyclo  int              `json:"sum_cyclo"`
88		SumCognit int              `json:"sum_cognit"`
89		MaxCognit int              `json:"max_cognit"`
90		Stmts     int              `json:"stmts"`
91		Covered   int              `json:"covered"`
92		Churn     map[string]Churn `json:"churn"` // key: "90d"
93		Feature   string           `json:"feature"`
94		Area      string           `json:"area"`
95		Funcs     []*Func          `json:"-"`
96		Imports   []string         `json:"-"`
97	}
98	
99	func (f *File) CovPct() float64 {
100		if f.Stmts == 0 {
101			return -1
102		}
103		return 100 * float64(f.Covered) / float64(f.Stmts)
104	}
105	
106	type Agg struct {
107		Name        string           `json:"name"`
108		Area        string           `json:"area,omitempty"`
109		Ranked      bool             `json:"ranked"`
110		Files       int              `json:"files"`
111		TestFiles   int              `json:"test_files"`
112		ProdLOC     int              `json:"prod_loc"`
113		TestLOC     int              `json:"test_loc"`
114		GenLOC      int              `json:"gen_loc"`
115		Funcs       int              `json:"funcs"`
116		SumCyclo    int              `json:"sum_cyclo"`
117		MaxCyclo    int              `json:"max_cyclo"`
118		SumCognit   int              `json:"sum_cognit"`
119		MaxCognit   int              `json:"max_cognit"`
120		OverCyclo   int              `json:"funcs_over_cyclo"`
121		OverCognit  int              `json:"funcs_over_cognit"`
122		Stmts       int              `json:"stmts"`
123		Covered     int              `json:"covered"`
124		UncovCognit int              `json:"uncovered_cognit"` // cognitive complexity in under-covered functions
125		Churn       map[string]Churn `json:"churn"`
126		FanIn       int              `json:"fan_in,omitempty"`
127		FanOut      int              `json:"fan_out,omitempty"`
128		cognitVals  []int
129	}
130	
131	func (a *Agg) CovPct() float64 {
132		if a.Stmts == 0 {
133			return -1
134		}
135		return 100 * float64(a.Covered) / float64(a.Stmts)
136	}
137	
138	func (a *Agg) TestRatio() float64 {
139		if a.ProdLOC == 0 {
140			return 0
141		}
142		return float64(a.TestLOC) / float64(a.ProdLOC)
143	}
144	
145	func (a *Agg) Density() float64 { // cognitive complexity per 100 prod LOC
146		if a.ProdLOC == 0 {
147			return 0
148		}
149		return 100 * float64(a.SumCognit) / float64(a.ProdLOC)
150	}
151	
152	func (a *Agg) MedianCognit() float64 {
153		if len(a.cognitVals) == 0 {
154			return 0
155		}
156		v := append([]int(nil), a.cognitVals...)
157		sort.Ints(v)
158		n := len(v)
159		if n%2 == 1 {
160			return float64(v[n/2])
161		}
162		return float64(v[n/2-1]+v[n/2]) / 2
163	}
164	
165	func (a *Agg) add(f *File, windows []string) {
166		a.Ranked = a.Ranked || f.Ranked
167		for _, w := range windows {
168			c := a.Churn[w]
169			fc := f.Churn[w]
170			c.Commits += fc.Commits
171			c.Added += fc.Added
172			c.Deleted += fc.Deleted
173			a.Churn[w] = c
174		}
175		if f.IsTest {
176			a.TestFiles++
177			a.TestLOC += f.LOC
178			return
179		}
180		a.Files++
181		if f.Generated {
182			a.GenLOC += f.LOC
183			return
184		}
185		a.ProdLOC += f.LOC
186		a.Stmts += f.Stmts
187		a.Covered += f.Covered
188		for _, fn := range f.Funcs {
189			a.Funcs++
190			a.SumCyclo += fn.Cyclo
191			a.SumCognit += fn.Cognit
192			a.cognitVals = append(a.cognitVals, fn.Cognit)
193			a.MaxCyclo = max(a.MaxCyclo, fn.Cyclo)
194			a.MaxCognit = max(a.MaxCognit, fn.Cognit)
195			if fn.Cyclo > *cycloWarn {
196				a.OverCyclo++
197			}
198			if fn.Cognit > *cognitWarn {
199				a.OverCognit++
200			}
201			if fn.Stmts > 0 && fn.CovPct() < *covWarn {
202				a.UncovCognit += fn.Cognit
203			}
204		}
205	}

3	// and splits that into EXCLUSIVE (reached by no other root) vs SHARED.

# tools/complexity — deterministic complexity baseline

Answers, per feature and per command: how much code is there, how hard is it
to read (gocyclo / gocognit), how much of it is exercised by tests, how often
it changes, and what each command exclusively owns.

This is a separate Go module (`cxtool`) so its dependencies stay out of the
CLI's `go.mod`; `go list ./...` from the repo root does not descend into it,
and it in turn skips nested modules when walking the tree.

## Pieces

| file | what |
| --- | --- |
| `main.go` | parses every non-test Go file (in parallel); per function LOC, cyclomatic (`fzipp/gocyclo`), cognitive (`uudashr/gocognit`); folds `go test -coverprofile` files in a single streaming pass (merged per block, max count) and `git log --numstat` churn (one git run, bucketed per window); rolls up by `features.json` |
| `reach/main.go` | builds SSA + a VTA call graph (`golang.org/x/tools/go/callgraph/vta`); every `*cobra.Command`-returning func is a root, plus `<init>` and one `<main:pkg>`; reports exclusive vs shared LOC per root and declarations no root reaches. Its precision policies (`-maxfanout` cutoff for unresolved dynamic calls, closures only via their creator, generic instantiations rolled up to their origin) are documented at the top of the file; `-who <substr>` explains why a symbol is or isn't reached |
| `dupl/main.go` | rolls a golangci-lint `dupl` JSON report up by feature |
| `internal/cx/` | the one home of the feature mapping (rule matching, rank policy), module-path reading, and CSV writing — shared by all three binaries |
| `features.json` | path → feature rules. Two ordered passes, first match wins in each: the literal path first (explicit `_test.go` rules always win), then the source-file name for test files. `norank: true` keeps a feature out of rankings and headline totals while still measuring it. Edit this when a command family moves; unmapped files are reported and counted in `report.json` meta |
| `render.py` | renders the HTML report from `report.json` + `reach.json` + `dupl-by-feature.json`. Its "Reading the numbers" section is snapshot-bound interpretation and says so |
| `dupl-config.yaml` | golangci config for the duplication scan (same recipe as `mise run dup`) |
| `baseline/<date>/` | snapshot of the outputs for that day, so a later run can be diffed |

## Run

From the repo root:

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/cx
# 1. coverage profiles (≈ 5 min; unit + in-process integration)
go test -count=1 -coverprofile=/tmp/cx/unit.out -coverpkg=./... ./...
go test -count=1 -tags=integration -coverprofile=/tmp/cx/int.out -coverpkg=./... \
  ./cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/... ./cmd/entire/cli/auth/...

cd tools/complexity
# 2. metrics + rollup (seconds)
go run .       -root ../.. -cover /tmp/cx/unit.out,/tmp/cx/int.out -out /tmp/cx/all
# 3. command reachability (seconds); -who SomeFunc explains one symbol
go run ./reach -root ../.. -out /tmp/cx/reach
# 4. duplication per feature
golangci-lint run -c dupl-config.yaml --new=false --max-issues-per-linter=0 \
  --max-same-issues=0 --output.json.path=/tmp/cx/dupl.json ../...
go run ./dupl  -in /tmp/cx/dupl.json -root ../.. -out /tmp/cx/dupl-by-feature.json
# 5. page
python3 render.py /tmp/cx/all /tmp/cx/reach /tmp/cx/dupl-by-feature.json ../.. /tmp/cx/baseline.html
```

All flags have `-h` help; thresholds are flags (`-cyclo-warn`, `-cognit-warn`,
`-cov-warn`), and their effective values travel in `report.json` meta so the
rendered page labels itself from data.

Outputs: `report.md` (human summary), `features.csv` / `areas.csv` /
`packages.csv` / `files.csv` / `functions.csv` (diffable tables), `report.json`
(everything, including meta), `reach.md` / `commands.csv` / `reach.json`.

## Reading the numbers

- **Σ cognit** — sum of cognitive complexity over a feature's functions; the
  best single "how much is there to understand" number.
- **cog/100** — cognitive complexity per 100 production lines; density.
  Parsers and renderers run high by nature; a command surface running high is a
  smell.
- **uncovered cognit** — cognitive complexity in functions with < `-cov-warn`
  statement coverage; the "complex and untested" number.
- **exclusive LOC** (reach) — code reachable from exactly one root; deleting
  that command frees this much. "reached LOC" is everything it can touch and
  is generous because of interface dispatch.
- **reached by no root** — nothing in the shipped binaries references it
  (tests excluded; reflection not modelled). Verify before deleting.

## Known limits

- Generated code (`ast.IsGenerated`) is counted in LOC but excluded from
  complexity.
- Coverage is statement coverage from the unit and integration suites; the
  e2e suite spawns binaries and is not included.
- VTA over-approximates dynamic dispatch; see the policy comment at the top of
  `reach/main.go` for how that is contained and what remains invisible
  (reflection, template lookups).
- Churn does not follow renames.

content.text:
/simplify is complete. All four review passes are applied, verified, and the artifact republished (same URL).

**Fixed (by theme, deduped from 4 agents' ~25 findings)**

- **One owner for shared policy** — new `internal/cx` package holds the feature rules, rank policy, module-path reading (`x/mod modfile.ModulePath` replaces two hand-rolled parsers), and CSV writing; all three binaries import it. `reach`'s drifted copy (no area, no test-file probe) is gone, and its output now carries `name`/`area`/`ranked` so the renderer stops re-deriving policy.
- **Exclusion policy now lives in `features.json`** as `norank: true` (test-infra, generated, vogon) and flows through every output — the renderer's five contradictory spellings collapsed to one predicate, and `report.md`'s ranking tables now apply the same policy the HTML does (they previously disagreed).
- **Contract repair** — the dual-probe matching that silently broke "first match wins" is now two ordered passes (explicit path beats derived), which un-deadened the `dogfood_hooks_test.go` rule; verified impact is exactly 141 test LOC moving to test-infra, nothing else.
- **Thresholds unfrozen** — `-cyclo-warn`/`-cognit-warn`/`-cov-warn` flags with schema-stable columns (`funcs_over_*`); effective values plus the unmapped tally travel in `report.json` meta, and the page labels itself from that (no more hardcoded "cut at 60", "0 files unmapped").
- **The missing pipeline stage exists** — `cxtool/dupl` turns golangci's JSON into `dupl-by-feature.json` (reproduces the ad-hoc numbers exactly: 117 prod / 787 test); README rewritten to the real pipeline.
- **Performance** — streaming profile parse instead of `cover.ParseProfiles` materializing+sorting 4.8M blocks, parallel file parsing, one `git log` bucketed across windows, precomputed successor lists + memoized `topDecl` in reach, render reads `report.json` only (no per-file rescan of 5,700 funcs). Main pass: **28s → 3.7s**; nested-module skip added so the tool no longer measures itself.
- **Dead weight removed** — `PkgDeps`, `ExclDeclKeys`, `Func.Generated`, `pct()`, `SEARCH`, dead style rules, the `-who` block's two fan-out-map rebuilds, the inert `-skip` defaults; `command()` lookups now raise on a rename instead of rendering 0; scatter labels follow one stable rule (top-12 by uncovered cognit); dark palette written once; median fixed; Reading section stamped as snapshot-bound with the rewind bullet updated to "since removed in #2178/#2186/#2187".

**Skipped, with reasons** — the "dark `data-theme` block is unreachable" claim (false positive: the artifact host stamps it); full HTML-template extraction (high churn on a stable page — the palette dedup removed the real pain); epoch-array BFS and generic sort helpers (over-engineering for a 5s tool); folding `report.md` into the renderer (two renderers是 deliberate — they now share policy and thresholds).

**Verified** — parity run against the same tree: complexity/coverage numbers identical everywhere, reach bit-identical (161 roots, 0 diffs), churn deltas proven to be pure window slide; `gofmt -s` + `go vet` clean; page re-rendered and visually checked; baseline snapshot regenerated in `tools/complexity/baseline/2026-08-30/`.

Also landed mid-stream: the #2187 Copilot fixes (`2c12d732e` — one consistent both-halves definition of the `--pending` dataset across all five sites plus four more the agent found contradicting it). The tooling itself is still uncommitted on this branch, ready for its PR whenever you say go.

Looked at it — **#2189 checks out and I'd approve it**. It's an outside contributor (MuskanPaliwal) doing exactly the two follow-ups our PR bodies flagged: the dead `ClaudeCodeAgent.FindCheckpointUUID` wrapper called out in #2187's description, and the agent-implementation comments the rename pass deliberately left rather than guess at.

**Verified, not just read:**

- **The method removal is safe.** No interface declares `FindCheckpointUUID`, nothing type-asserts for it, and its only non-test reference was its own body — matching our call-graph data (0 owners). The deleted integration subtest was the only exerciser.
- **The comment rewrites are accurate**: codex's `ResolveSessionFile` ("attach/rewind must recover" → "callers recover"), the two security-contract test doc comments ("resume/rewind guard" → "checkpoint-session restoration guard" — the validator behavior they pin is unchanged), and opencode's import-flow comments now describe restore/resume without claiming rewind. All consistent with what actually remains after #2178/#2187.
- **It's rename-aware**: the branch merged `main` post-#2187, so it edits the current text.
- **CI is fully green** (nothing failed, nothing pending), no bot findings, and #2187 is indeed merged (10:17Z).

Two honest observations for whoever reviews it, neither blocking:

1. It removes the *wrapper* but keeps the package-level `claudecode/transcript.go:FindCheckpointUUID` primitive, which now has **no non-test caller either** — the PR body says this is deliberate ("remains independently tested and unchanged"). Fine, but it's now test-only exported API.

Yes — that's the more thorough version, and the call-graph data says it's available. The full dead cluster around these helpers, all 0-owner in the reach analysis (tests excluded, `main`/`init` included):

| Block | LOC | What it is |
|---|---:|---|
| `claudecode/claude.go` wrappers: `ReadSession`, `GetSessionID`, `TruncateAtUUID`, `ReadSessionFromPath` (+ `FindCheckpointUUID`, which #2189 already takes) | ~92 | agent-object conveniences over the transcript primitives |
| `claudecode/transcript.go`: `FindCheckpointUUID`, `SerializeTranscript`, `TruncateAtUUID` | ~45 | the primitives — after #2189 the first is test-only |
| `agent/session.go`: `TruncateAtUUID`, `FindToolResultUUID`, `GetLastUserPrompt`, `GetLastAssistantResponse` | ~58 | generic session helpers with the same fate |
| `codex/codex.go`: `ReadSession`, `GetSessionID` | ~42 | same pattern, Codex flavor |
| `opencode/opencode.go` equivalents | ~53 | same pattern |

So "remove 1+2 too" is really "remove the whole restore-era session-helper family" — roughly **250–300 LOC of exported-but-unreachable API plus its tests**, the same shape as the rewind removal and verifiable the same way (`reach -who` per symbol + grep). That also matches the repo's own stance (the de-slop rule: wire it or drop it), and none of these are on any interface — I checked for interface declarations and type-asserts when reviewing #2189, and `RestoreLogsOnly`/resume construct sessions without them.

Two caveats before committing to it:

1. **Not in #2189.** I'd merge that PR as-is — it's correct, green, and expanding a first-time contributor's scope under them is poor form. The cluster removal is a clean follow-up on top.
2. **One judgment call per agent**: `external/external.go` has a similar 0-owner set (`Info`, `ReadSession`, …) but that's the external-agent protocol surface, which may be *intended* API for plugins rather than leftovers — per the repo's "flag it, don't decide it" culture, that one should be flagged in the PR body, not deleted.

Want me to queue the subagent on it once #2189 merges? Same recipe as the rewind PR: verify each symbol with the reach tool, delete the cluster plus its tests, flag `external` as deliberately kept, full `test:ci`, PR referencing #2178/#2189.

input.message:
Task handoff from the soph-complexity session (Stefan asked me to pass this to you): remove the dead "restore-era" session-helper cluster across the agent packages — the follow-up to PRs #2178 (rewind restore path removal), #2187 (pending-checkpoint rename) and #2189 (first slice of this cleanup, approved and merging soon).

## Wait for #2189 first
#2189 removes `ClaudeCodeAgent.FindCheckpointUUID` and touches `claudecode/claude.go` — branch from main AFTER it merges (check `gh pr view 2189 --json state`) or you'll conflict. Branch name suggestion: whatever fits your worktree; base `origin/main`.

## What to remove — all verified 0-owner by whole-program reachability (cobra commands + main + init as roots; tests excluded)
1. `cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/claude.go` — the remaining agent-method wrappers with no production caller: `ReadSession`, `GetSessionID`, `TruncateAtUUID`, `ReadSessionFromPath` (~92 LOC before #2189; slightly less after).
2. `cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode/transcript.go` — `FindCheckpointUUID` (test-only after #2189), `SerializeTranscript`, `TruncateAtUUID` (~45 LOC) — delete whichever are left caller-less once (1) lands; re-verify each.
3. `cmd/entire/cli/agent/session.go` — `TruncateAtUUID`, `FindToolResultUUID`, `GetLastUserPrompt`, `GetLastAssistantResponse` (~58 LOC).
4. `cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/codex.go` — `ReadSession`, `GetSessionID` (~42 LOC) and any codex-local helper that becomes unused.
5. `cmd/entire/cli/agent/opencode/opencode.go` — the equivalent unused readers (~53 LOC; identify by verification, don't guess from this list).
Plus the tests that exist only to exercise the removed functions, and any helpers the `unused` linter flags afterwards. Removal cascades: after deleting the wrappers, re-check the primitives they called.

## Deliberately NOT in scope
- `cmd/entire/cli/agent/external/` — its `Info`/`ReadSession`/etc. are also 0-owner, but that package is the external-agent protocol surface and may be intended plugin API. Per the repo's "flag it, don't decide it" rule: leave it, and note it in the PR body as a flagged judgment call for a human.
- Anything on a Go interface or reached via type-assert — none of the listed symbols are, but verify per symbol before deleting (see below).
- `RestoreLogsOnly` / resume machinery — live, feeds `entire resume`.

## How to verify each symbol (use this, don't re-derive)
A reachability tool lives (uncommitted) at `/Users/soph/.herdr/worktrees/cli/soph-complexity/tools/complexity/`. From that directory:
  go run ./reach -root <YOUR_REPO_ROOT> -features features.json -out /tmp/reach-check -who <SymbolName>
`-who` prints owners ("0 owners" = dead from the binaries) and incoming call edges. Takes ~15s. Also grep for each name in non-test code and check no interface declares it (`git grep -nE 'SymbolName\(' -- '*.go' | grep -v _test`). Delete only 0-owner symbols whose non-test grep is clean.

## Repo rules (from CLAUDE.md — read it, but the load-bearing ones):
- Per commit: `mise run fmt && mise run lint` clean on the formatted tree; `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/...` pass. Before push: full `mise run test:ci`. Known pre-existing failure on this machine: `TestCodexAppServerHooksList_*` can fail on clean main on macOS with codex installed — if it fires, confirm on main and say so in the PR rather than chasing it. `test:ci` may rewrite `.opencode/package-lock.json` — never `git add -A`; stage by name.
- Never bare `git stash` (shared stash stack across worktrees).
- Entire is enabled; commits are captured automatically — don't run entire enable/disable/clean/auth.
- Commit style: imperative subject ≤~70 chars, body explaining what/why with the evidence (0 owners, tests-only callers), Co-Authored-By trailer per your harness.

## PR
`gh pr create --base main`, title like "Remove the dead session-helper API left from the restore era". Body: what was removed per file with LOC, the verification method (reachability + grep), what was deliberately kept (`external/` flagged; anything you found actually live), links to #2178/#2187/#2189. No filler. End with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
